output.explanation:
The central tree retains the four perspectives while shrinking from 157 to 107 lines (31.8%) and from 11,021 to 7,634 characters (30.7%). Five peripheral trees expand meaningful component, call, ownership and data-dependency nodes. Positions use measured text dimensions with gaps; all edge anchors are 1-based raw lines.

Corrections to the seed: ChatDiagramTools.call submits supplied content through submitDirect; DiagramEditService.generate separately chooses submitStoredDiagramEdit or generator-backed generation. The central tree therefore separates direct chat submission from the general batch workflow instead of implying that direct chat edits invoke Pi. AgentChatService.interrupt is separate from receive, and callBoundTool is a parallel entry into dispatchTool rather than a continuation of native tool handling. GenerationCanvasBridge.dispatch rejects inactive generation-* IDs instead of forwarding every unknown ID to the live port. FakeDiagramEditRuntime is a sibling implementation of DiagramGenerator, not part of PiDiagramEditRuntime.

Added source-grounded detail includes tool catalog refresh and retained tokens (AgentChatService.reloadTools; MappingChatMcpBinding), attachment caching and run ownership (ChatDiagramTools), exact fork boundaries, generation usage baselines and replay inputs (AgentChatService), controller identity and receipt ordering (GenerationCanvasBridge), mapping-policy checks and retained accepted submissions (generatedDiagramEdit.ts; validatedSubmission.ts), application-error classification (DiagramBatchService; DiagramEditService), and event buffering and RPC lifetimes (AgentChatService; StdioCodexConnection).

Only the supplied point, pinned source text and seed were used as evidence. HTTP routing, submitDirect-to-batch wiring, and imported revision/controller/storage implementations are not supplied; their internal behavior is not independently established here. The diagrams show the visible calls and contracts without asserting database transaction guarantees or filesystem isolation for child generations.

Agent Chat and Generation
|-- [M] Modular structure: contracts, boundaries and dependencies
|   |-- Conversation interface: AgentChatPanel
|   |   |-- Exposes tabs, send, Read Canvas, stop, resume and pending answers
|   |   `-- HTTP requests + session event stream; drafts and stream handling internal
|   |-- Conversation coordination: AgentChatService
|   |   |-- Exposes session operations, subscriptions, tool calls and alternatives
|   |   |-- Depends on CodexConnection + ChatStore
|   |   `-- Optional canvas reader, ChatTools, MCP, generation bridge, context library
|   |-- Bound canvas tools: ChatDiagramTools + MappingChatMcpBinding
|   |   |-- Diagram edits, creation, extension, contexts, views and run status
|   |   |-- ChatDiagramTools -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |   |-- MCP binding -> agent.chatBindings: canvas target + read-only setting
|   |   `-- AgentChatService intercepts gen-alternatives; delegates other tools
|   |-- Revision workflow: DiagramEditService + DiagramBatchService
|   |   |-- Exposes start, get, wait and cancel; depends on revision/context logic
|   |   |-- DiagramEditCanvasPort: snapshot, apply and optional create
|   |   `-- Batch service collects edits + creations for one canvas application
|   |-- Execution adapters: distinct contracts
|   |   |-- StdioCodexConnection: chat threads/events <-> Codex app-server stdio
|   |   |-- PiDiagramEditRuntime: DiagramGenerator backed by PiAgentRuntime
|   |   `-- FakeDiagramEditRuntime: another DiagramGenerator implementation
|   `-- Canvas isolation: GenerationCanvasBridge implements CanvasSessionPort
|       |-- Active child IDs -> private MappingDocumentController instances
|       |-- Non-generation IDs -> supplied live CanvasSessionPort
|       `-- Inactive generation IDs and unsupported child operations are rejected
|-- [C] Calls: activations and continuations
|   |-- Conversation turn
|   |   `-- Panel HTTP send / Read Canvas -> service send/readCanvas -> startTurn
|   |       |-- Reject overlapping startup, running turn or tool reload
|   |       |-- Resume if needed; capture references; bind canvas access
|   |       |-- Persist client request ID -> CodexConnection.request('turn/start')
|   |       `-- Native messages -> AgentChatService.receive
|   |           |-- Items/deltas -> reduce state -> subscribers -> panel ChatStream
|   |           |-- Questions/approvals -> pending -> answer -> connection.respond
|   |           |-- Native tool call -> callTool -> dispatchTool
|   |           `-- Turn completed -> settle items, persist; finishGeneration if child
|   |-- MCP tool entry -> callBoundTool -> dispatchTool
|   |-- Parent interrupt -> cancel active generation children -> turn/interrupt
|   |-- Independent canvas alternatives: AgentChatService.genAlternatives
|   |   |-- Require writable parent, canvas, tools and prior user message; no nesting
|   |   |-- Matching request receipt reused; changed arguments for same ID rejected
|   |   |-- Save children -> canvas-generation(start) -> retain input history
|   |   `-- Schedule launchGeneration independently for each candidate
|   |       |-- Saved AgentContext -> new thread; otherwise fork parent conversation
|   |       |-- Clear inherited goal -> add isolated controller -> startTurn
|   |       `-- finishGeneration: retain history, sync terminal result, release binding
|   |-- Direct chat diagram edit, create or extend
|   |   `-- ChatDiagramTools.call -> prepare -> agent.submitDirect
|   |       |-- Resolve reference/target against one canvas snapshot
|   |       `-- Reject stale revisions, mixed documents and incomplete subtrees
|   |-- Batch processing: DiagramBatchService.start
|   |   |-- Common snapshot; reject duplicate edit targets; run children sequentially
|   |   |-- Child DiagramEditService: version checks, scope, template, references
|   |   |   |-- Supplied diagram -> submitStoredDiagramEdit
|   |   |   `-- Without submission -> generateDiagram(DiagramGenerator, ...)
|   |   `-- Collect child applications -> canvas.batch once
|   |       |-- Success -> completed with version and unresolved edge IDs
|   |       `-- Conflict or awaiting-acknowledgement on qualifying application errors
|   `-- Standalone DiagramEditService installation
|       |-- Edit -> apply revision or store variants with expected document/base versions
|       `-- Create/extend -> latest placement snapshot -> create; up to 3 conflict attempts
|-- [O] Ownership: state, persistence and lifetime
|   |-- AgentChatPanel owns transient interaction state
|   |   |-- Per-tab drafts/settings and pending send/read request identities
|   |   `-- Session change/unmount closes stream; closing tab retains conversation
|   |-- AgentChatService owns active session bookkeeping
|   |   |-- Sessions, thread lookup, listeners, pending interactions and delta buffers
|   |   |-- ChatStore retains conversations, generation inputs, metadata and results
|   |   |-- Restart: running chat -> interrupted; active generation -> failed
|   |   `-- Disposal settles activity, persists status, clears bindings and connection
|   |-- StdioCodexConnection owns one lazily started app-server process
|   |   |-- RPC IDs, pending promises, response timers and event listeners
|   |   `-- Response/timeout settles request; process failure rejects pending requests
|   |-- Each generation child has its own thread, binding and controller
|   |   |-- Bridge owns controller, serialized command queue and mutation receipts
|   |   |-- Mutation -> retain receipt -> persist exported history -> acknowledge
|   |   `-- Settlement removes controller; history and child conversation remain
|   |-- DiagramEditService owns request generation and installation
|   |   |-- Retains revisions, variants, contexts and AbortController
|   |   |-- Cancel aborts generation; dispatched application is not cancelled
|   |   `-- DiagramBatchService owns child runs and retained final application
|   `-- Pi runtime owns active model sessions
|       |-- SessionManager persists prompts, tool calls and usage on disk
|       `-- Generation finally detaches handlers, unsubscribes and disposes session
`-- [D] Data dependency: what results require, independent of organization
    |-- Editable request
    |   |-- Chat reference or explicit node ID + canvas target
    |   |-- Current snapshot: document version, diagram identity and base revision
    |   `-- Whole diagram or complete subtrees -> permitted replacement ranges
    |-- Validated revision
    |   |-- Candidate ASCII + structure kind + optional mappings/replacement ranges
    |   |-- Direct candidate OR generated content from prompt and captured context
    |   |-- Base source binding/evidence + logical identities + mapping policy
    |   `-- Schema, continuity, diagram and scope checks precede accepted output
    |-- Applied edit result
    |   |-- Validated revision/variants + expected document version and base revision
    |   `-- Canvas receipt -> resulting document version and unresolved edge IDs
    |-- Candidate canvas result
    |   |-- Captured source history seeds independent child controllers
    |   |-- Parent conversation fork OR supplied saved AgentContext
    |   |-- Shared task + candidate prompt + inherited model/effort/tool definitions
    |   `-- Child history + terminal status -> finished history saved to candidate view
    `-- Retry decision
        |-- Request identity + argument signature -> reuse or conflict
        |-- Retained revision/application -> retry installation without model rerun
        `-- Retained generation history -> retry saving without regeneration

Bound tools: authority and catalog lifetime
|-- Entry checks in AgentChatService
|   |-- Native call: known tool, no namespace, running turn, matching turn ID
|   |-- MCP call: valid token, canvasTools, running session, no tool reload
|   `-- Both reach dispatchTool; gen-alternatives stays in the chat service
|-- MappingChatMcpBinding owns token and catalog-generation maps
|   |-- config requires origin; creates token through agent.chatBindings
|   |-- bind associates token with canvas target and read-only flag
|   `-- clear clears the agent binding; local token entry remains
|-- Tool reload keeps the existing conversation
|   |-- Refuse reload during running turn or startup
|   |-- Snapshot definitions -> unsubscribe -> resume with refreshed MCP config
|   |-- New generation UUID bypasses cached catalog; request MCP reload
|   |-- Verify every chat_<tool> exists in mapping server inventory
|   `-- Inject updated-tool guidance; save definitions and toolsReloadedAt
|-- ChatDiagramTools prepares direct diagram submissions
|   |-- Exactly one of reference or nodeId; all operations share one document
|   |-- Resolve aliases; snapshot once; require current baseRevisionId
|   |-- Node selections must contain complete subtrees
|   |-- Cache prepared request by chat/request ID; changed arguments conflict
|   `-- submitDirect returns run ID; owners map gates status and cancellation
|-- Other exposed capabilities absent from the seed's overview
|   |-- Saved AgentContext operations delegate through agent.call
|   |-- Highlights resolve current anchors -> exec -> mutation receipts
|   `-- Projection resolves diagram IDs -> identity version -> project-diagrams
`-- Private attachment cache
    |-- Canvas target -> promise of attached session ID
    `-- Failed attachment evicts entry so a later attempt can retry

Independent alternatives: captured inputs and child lifetime
|-- genAlternatives captures the parent and source canvas
|   |-- Persist candidate chats + parent request receipt before canvas start
|   |-- canvas-generation(start) returns history
|   `-- Save history plus a separate inputHistory clone for each child
|-- launchGeneration schedules a separate thread for every candidate
|   |-- Saved context: prefer resolvedSnapshot, otherwise snapshot
|   |   `-- thread/start -> inject captured AgentContext as background material
|   |-- Without saved context: thread/fork
|   |   |-- Running parent with turn ID -> beforeTurnId
|   |   `-- Otherwise parent turn ID -> lastTurnId
|   `-- Clear inherited goal -> create bridge controller -> start one managed turn
|-- GenerationCanvasBridge owns isolated canvas state
|   |-- documentFromHistory + saved view -> MappingDocumentController
|   |-- Fresh history contextId; initial controller version is 0
|   |-- Child workspaceInstanceId and documentId use the same generation ID
|   `-- Commands require matching documentId and enter a per-child queue
|-- finishGeneration determines terminal status
|   |-- Already cancelled or chat interrupted -> cancelled
|   |-- Chat idle -> finished; otherwise -> failed
|   |-- Persist metadata + latest exported child history
|   |-- Sync finished history; failed/cancelled updates carry metadata only
|   `-- Clear binding, remove controller, unsubscribe thread; retain chat
|-- Reconnection can finish saving a retained result
|   |-- syncGeneration can rematch stableWorkspaceId + documentId
|   `-- generations retries unsynced terminal results and reports pendingSave
|-- Usage attribution excludes inherited fork totals
|   |-- First complete usage event: baseline = max(0, total - last)
|   `-- Candidate usage = max(0, total - baseline), for each token counter
`-- rerunAlternatives reuses the child-chat executor
    |-- Retained source history + original settings/tools + parent turn boundary
    `-- Reopen/rematch source canvas; create a new run from stored prompts

Validated output: dependencies and acceptance boundary
|-- DiagramEditService chooses how to produce content
|   |-- Supplied submission -> submitStoredDiagramEdit
|   `-- Otherwise -> generateDiagram with DiagramGenerator
|-- PiDiagramEditRuntime requires captured base diagram
|   |-- Render template/options, instruction, pinned references and connections
|   |-- Include editable ranges and logical node references
|   |-- Resolve optional AgentContext sources before creating session
|   `-- Enable only submit_diagram_edit; disable ambient skills/context files
|-- validateGeneratedDiagramEdit
|   |-- Strict schema: ASCII <= 200000 before continuity cleanup
|   |-- structureKind is diagram or tree; ranges/mappings are optional fields
|   |-- Mappings disabled: reject nonempty mappings
|   |-- Mappings enabled: require mappings field; empty array is allowed
|   |-- Strip continuity markers; reject blank content, CR and tabs
|   |-- Build content; each continuity line must identify exactly one node
|   `-- validateDiagram uses base evidence and candidate mappings
|-- Pi submission adds scope validation
|   |-- Scoped edits must preserve structure kind
|   `-- scopedReplacements checks candidate against permitted ranges
|-- createValidatedSubmission owns the accepted candidate
|   |-- Invalid -> issues + correction prompt; terminate: false
|   |-- Valid -> replace retained candidate; terminate: true
|   `-- A later rejection does not clear a previously accepted value
`-- After session.prompt returns
    |-- No accepted candidate -> error
    |-- Revalidate accepted candidate; attach base source binding/evidence
    `-- Finally remove abort handler, unsubscribe and dispose session

Retries: identity, retained work and application outcomes
|-- Panel and chat turn
|   |-- Lost send/read response retains request body and requestId
|   |-- Explicit ChatRequestError clears the pending client request
|   `-- Service persists requestId before turn/start; repeats return early
|-- DiagramBatchService
|   |-- Key = sessionId + requestId; signature includes operation and direct flag
|   |-- One snapshot; reject duplicate diagram targets for edit batches
|   |-- Sequential child runs collect edits/creations through adapter ports
|   |-- Retain application -> canvas.batch
|   |-- Applying + timeout/unavailable/persistence-pending -> awaiting-acknowledgement
|   |-- VERSION_CONFLICT -> conflict; other errors -> failed
|   `-- Same request in awaiting-acknowledgement retries retained application
|-- Standalone DiagramEditService
|   |-- Retains generated revision/variants/creations for installation
|   |-- Same acknowledgement retry rule; no model rerun
|   |-- Placement retries VERSION_CONFLICT at most 3 times using latest snapshot
|   `-- cancel only changes runs still generating
|-- GenerationCanvasBridge command receipts
|   |-- Mutation needs requestId; key = method + requestId
|   |-- Signature covers entire command; changed command -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |-- Apply once -> retain receipt -> persist controller history -> return value
|   |-- Persistence failure leaves receipt: identical retry persists without reapply
|   `-- Queue catches rejection so later commands can still execute
`-- Persistence boundaries differ
    |-- Batch/edit run maps and bridge receipt maps live in memory
    |-- ChatStore retains generation history and parent generation receipts
    `-- Restart marks active generations failed; saving retained results can retry

Execution adapters: separate contracts and resources
|-- CodexConnection: chat RPC and native event transport
|   |-- StdioCodexConnection lazily spawns one app-server
|   |-- initialize -> initialized; stderr is drained
|   |-- Numeric RPC IDs own pending promises and 30-second timers
|   |-- Replies clear timers; malformed JSON lines are ignored
|   |-- Process failure rejects pending requests and notifies subscribers
|   `-- dispose kills the child process
|-- AgentChatService adapts native events to session updates
|   |-- Thread ID -> chat session; unknown request threads are rejected
|   |-- Deltas coalesce by item/kind with a 32 ms flush timer
|   |-- Text burst over 64000 characters or non-delta message flushes buffer
|   |-- Read Canvas sends short context as read_canvas toolOutput with empty input
|   `-- turn/start response sets turnId only if session is still running
`-- DiagramGenerator: captured request -> generated diagram content
    |-- PiAgentRuntime gates AI enablement, model availability and configured auth
    |-- Model ID: override, NEW_DIAGRAM_MODEL, then default
    |-- Lazy ModelRuntime; create session with disk SessionManager
    |-- PiDiagramEditRuntime prompts and receives a validated submission
    |-- Progress reports composing, reading context or validating from events
    |-- Runtime dispose aborts/disposes all tracked active sessions
    `-- FakeDiagramEditRuntime produces content with instruction markers
        |-- Creation emits a created marker; edits append instruction markers
        `-- Returns correspondence only for unambiguous retained node lines
